correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

N=26
grid=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
def put(color, cells, dr=0, dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if not (0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N): print('OOB',color,rr,cc); continue
        if grid[rr][cc] not in (0,color): print('COLLISION',rr,cc,grid[rr][cc],color)
        grid[rr][cc]=color
def anchors(coords, dr=0,dc=0):
    for r,c in coords:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if grid[rr][cc] not in (0,2): print('ANCHOR COLLISION',rr,cc,grid[rr][cc])
        grid[rr][cc]=2
